title: Quantization Profile Library — Eval Results Sheet (baseline vs quantized)
content:
Doc: spreadsheet-style rollup for Quantization Profile Library gating (MVP)
Owner: Jonas Weber (Evals/Perf)
Last updated: 2025-02-22
Data sources: eval-harness (baseline vs quantized comparison job), benchmark-lab perf suite GPU matrix runs

How to read this sheet
- Baseline = bf16/fp16 serving path (per-model default in runtime); Quantized = Redwood-published quant profile (int8 or int4)
- Quality deltas reported as relative change vs baseline unless otherwise noted
- Perf deltas measured at fixed load shapes (see Perf tab) and reported as improvement vs baseline
- PASS/FAIL criteria (MVP draft; aligns with current acceptance discussion in eng-ml thread 1730839112):
  - Quality gate: (a) No critical format regressions (JSON-validity drop > 0.5pp OR tool-call success drop > 1.0pp) AND (b) Overall score regression <= 1.0% on the prompt set aggregate
  - Perf gate: (a) Throughput +20% or better OR (b) Cost-per-1k-tokens improvement >= 15% (modeled) with no p95 latency regression > 10% at same concurrency
  - Overall: PASS only if both quality gate and perf gate PASS for that GPU SKU + sequence regime

Prompt sets (eval-harness)
- PS-CHAT-001: General chat (short/medium)
- PS-SUMM-002: Summarization (short + batch-style)
- PS-LCTX-003: Long context (8k–32k; emphasis on retrieval + coherence)
- PS-JSON-004: JSON mode / structured output validity
- PS-TOOL-005: Tool-calling correctness (function selection + arguments)
- PS-CODE-006: Code generation (unit-test style; lightweight)

GPU SKUs covered (perf + runtime compatibility)
- NVIDIA H100 SXM (80GB)
- NVIDIA A100 SXM (80GB)
- NVIDIA L40S (48GB)

============================================================
TAB: NOTES / OPEN ISSUES
============================================================
1) A100 path for qwen2.5-14b-int8
- Symptom: consistent quality regression on PS-CHAT and PS-JSON; perf gain below gate.
- Hypotheses: calibration set skew (too short), kernel fallback to less optimized path on A100, activation outliers.
- Action: Priyanka to regenerate calibration with 30% JSON/tool prompts + longer contexts; Hiro to verify kernel selection trace tags.

2) Llama3.1-70b-int8 long-context perf regression
- Symptom: p95 latency regression +16% at 8k/1k shape; throughput only +18%.
- Suspect: scheduler interaction with continuous batching + KV cache pressure; potential micro-batch fragmentation.
- Action: runtime team to run A/B with alternative batching caps; capture per-token latency breakdown (prefill vs decode).

3) int4 profiles and structured output
- Pattern: PS-JSON + PS-TOOL regressions are the primary blockers (not general chat).
- Proposed product stance: do not ship int4 as a general-purpose profile in MVP; if requested, gate behind route type + mandatory canary + easy rollback.

4) Metrics sanity
- Logan/Nadia confirmed tags exist to separate baseline vs quant execution mode (see redwood/pr_28833). Need to ensure dashboards segment by route + profile_id.

5) Reminder: when we publish, we must include explicit hardware scoping
- Some perf wins on H100 do not translate to A100 due to kernel differences; profiles must declare supported GPU arch + tested sequence regimes.
